findings: The Winstons (Italy) is a psychedelic/progressive rock trio formed in Milan in 2015/2016 by three established indie rock musicians using pseudonyms (Linnon/Rob/Enro Winston). Members: Lino Gitto (Linnon), Roberto Dell'Era (Rob, also of Afterhours/Le Vibrazioni), Enrico Gabrielli (Enro, also of Calibro 35/Mariposa). Sound bridges jazz, rock, psychedelia, Canterbury scene influences. Debut album 'The Winstons' released January 2016 on AMS Records. Followed by 'Pictures At An Exhibition' (2017, with EdMsC) and 'Smith' (2019). Also released 7-inch single 'Golden Brown/Black Shopping Bag' (2016). CRITICAL: This band formed in 2016 — outside the project's 1985-2000 scope. Inclusion likely due to name confusion with the 1960s American funk/soul band The Winstons (Amen break). Found presence on Bandcamp, Spotify, YouTube Music, Facebook, ProgArchives, AllMusic, RateYourMusic, Rolling Stone Italia, OndaRock, Guitar.com, Noise Symphony, NonSoloProgRock, PleniROCKium, AMS Records, Rockliquias. No evidence of 1980s/1990s underground Italian activity.
